settings.title: Graduated compression
settings.text: [compression] of support, firmest at the ankle and easing off gradually towards the knee.

settings.title: Made for long days
settings.text: Designed for tired, heavy or fatigued legs, whether you're standing through a shift, sitting at a desk or travelling.

settings.title: Sized by your ankle
settings.text: Chosen by ankle circumference rather than shoe size alone, for a fit that suits your leg.

settings.title: Soft, all-season blend
settings.text: Combed cotton, polyamide and elastane: soft on the skin, with comfortable stretch, in winter or summer.

settings.compression_text:
Graduated: strongest at the ankle and gradually decreasing up the leg, built into the knit on compression-knitting machines. Knee-high, ending just under the knee. Sized by ankle circumference.

Please note: This product is designed for everyday compression and is not intended for diagnosed medical conditions requiring therapeutic compression. If you have a medical condition or persistent swelling, please consult an Orthotist or healthcare professional. Our Orthotist is available for guidance at www.cajeebotes.com
settings.fabric_text: Comfort in every thread. Made with a carefully selected blend of combed cotton, polyamide and elastane for a soft feel, comfortable stretch and lasting wear.
settings.care_text: Hand wash every 2–3 days in cold water using a mild soap. Gently remove excess water and leave them to air dry in the shade. Avoid bleach, harsh detergents, tumble drying and excessive heat.
settings.wear_text:
Putting them on

  1. Put them on in the morning, before you start your day.
  2. Turn the sock inside out down to the heel, slip your foot in and line up the heel.
  3. Ease the sock up your leg a little at a time rather than pulling from the cuff.
  4. Smooth out any wrinkles. The cuff sits just under the knee, so don't fold or roll it down.

How they should feel

They should feel snug and supportive without causing pain, numbness, tingling or significant discomfort. The sock should sit smoothly against your leg without excessive bunching or rolling.

When to wear them

Every day: while working, commuting, travelling or spending long periods on your feet, and on flights and other long journeys where you may be sitting for extended periods.

settings.question: How long are Vital Socks?
settings.answer: Knee-high. Vital Socks end just under the knee.

settings.question: What are Vital Socks made of?
settings.answer: Our socks are made from a blend of combed cotton, polyamide and elastane. Combed cotton provides a soft, comfortable feel against the skin, while polyamide adds durability and helps the socks retain their shape. Elastane provides the stretch needed for a comfortable, supportive fit. Together, these materials create a soft, durable sock designed for everyday wear, no matter the season.

settings.question: What if my ankle and calf point to different sizes?
settings.answer: Your ankle measurement sets the size. If your calf is outside that size's calf range, send us both measurements before you order and we'll advise you.
